strings.zh: 欢迎光临！{NEWLINE}新圣安努号游轮欢迎您！{SCROLL}……说是这样,{NEWLINE}引擎的保养还真是花时间呢！{SCROLL}目前还没有任何出航计划……
strings.en: Welcome! Welcome aboard the new{NEWLINE}S.S. Anne!{SCROLL}...Or so I’d like to say. The engine{NEWLINE}maintenance sure is taking its time!{SCROLL}We don’t have any departures scheduled{NEWLINE}yet...
strings.notes: The hack renamed the ship: 新圣安努号 = the new S.S. Anne (US had Fast Ship S.S. Aqua).

strings.zh: 欢迎光临！{NEWLINE}高速船圣安努号欢迎您！{CLEAR}这位客人,您的船票？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome aboard the fast ship S.S. Anne!{NEWLINE}May I see your S.S. Ticket, please?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}{NEWLINE}想要出示船票{SCROLL}……可是,没有船票。{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} tried to show the{NEWLINE}S.S. Ticket...{SCROLL}...But no Ticket here!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 这样啊……{SCROLL}虽然想让您免费乘坐,{CLEAR}但规定就是规定,{CLEAR}还请您能够谅解。
strings.en: I see...{SCROLL}I’d love to let you ride for free, but a{NEWLINE}rule is a rule. I hope you understand.
strings.notes: US 0255/3 | RV051: meaning: US invented 'another person without a Ticket' (D-1730)

strings.zh: 嗯哈~验票完毕！{SCROLL}马上就要出航咯！{NEWLINE}快点上船吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: OK, you have a Ticket!{SCROLL}We’re departing soon.{NEWLINE}Get on board quick!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 怎么？{NEWLINE}船票已经看过了哦。
strings.en: What?{NEWLINE}You already showed me the Ticket.

strings.zh: 欢迎光临水绿号！{SCROLL}请出示船票……{NEWLINE}嗯,请进吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome to the S.S. Aqua!{SCROLL}Your Ticket is...right there.{NEWLINE}Please come through.{SCROLL}
strings.notes: zh still says 水绿号 (S.S. Aqua) here, a leftover of the vanilla name; kept the US line. Consider changing to S.S. Anne for consistency. | coordinator: S.S. Aqua → S.S. Anne (hack renamed the ship) | D-1195 + user 2026-09-29: follow the zh 水绿号 = S.S. Aqua (hack finding: probably not renamed)

strings.zh: 船如果每天航行的话,{NEWLINE}也是会累的哦！{CLEAR}今天是停航的日子。{SCROLL}往枯叶市的航次{NEWLINE}是在星期一和星期五{CLEAR}请按时前来！
strings.en: Operating a ship every day can wear you{NEWLINE}out! It’s not running today.{SCROLL}It leaves for Vermilion City on Mondays{NEWLINE}and Fridays. Please be on time!
strings.notes: US 0255/8 | RV051: omission: zh 请按时前来

strings.zh: 大木博士『哦~{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}总觉得……你越来越有{CLEAR}冠军的风范了！{SCROLL}既然当上了冠军,{NEWLINE}精灵图鉴{CLEAR}也应该做得与冠军{CLEAR}相称才行！{SCROLL}来,把图鉴给我一下！{NEWLINE}我帮你把图鉴{CLEAR}升级成全国版的吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Prof. Oak: Hello!{NEWLINE}You are starting to have the{CLEAR}attitude of a Champion, {VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}It’s time for your Pokédex to match{NEWLINE}who you are.{CLEAR}Let me see your Pokédex for a second.{SCROLL}I’ll upgrade your Pokédex with{NEWLINE}the National Mode.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 大木博士『哦~{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}总觉得……你越来越有{CLEAR}冠军的风范了！{SCROLL}既然当上了冠军,{NEWLINE}精灵图鉴{CLEAR}也应该做得与冠军{CLEAR}相称才行！{SCROLL}来,把图鉴给我一下！{NEWLINE}我帮你把图鉴{CLEAR}升级成全国版的吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Prof. Oak: Hello!{NEWLINE}You are starting to have the...{CLEAR}attitude of a Champion, {VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}It’s time for your Pokédex to match{NEWLINE}who you are.{CLEAR}Let me see your Pokédex for a second.{SCROLL}I’ll upgrade your Pokédex with{NEWLINE}the National Mode.{SCROLL}
{VAR:0103:0}’s Pokédex was upgraded{NEWLINE}with the National Mode!

strings.zh: 大木博士『要完成{NEWLINE}全国图鉴{CLEAR}估计不是件简单的事呢……{CLEAR}请继续努力！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Prof. Oak: It won’t be easy to complete{NEWLINE}the National Pokédex... Please keep up{CLEAR}the good work!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0255/12 | RV051: meaning: zh 请继续努力, US 'on our behalf' not in zh

strings.zh: 哦呀！{NEWLINE}已经这么晚了！{SCROLL}我现在要去满金市的广播电台{NEWLINE}录节目去了！{SCROLL}你终于要向关东地区进发了吧？{SCROLL}我的研究所在一个叫真新镇的小镇里。{SCROLL}如果你到了那里附近的话,{NEWLINE}让我看看你的图鉴吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh my! Is it that late already?{SCROLL}I have a radio show to record at the{NEWLINE}radio station in Goldenrod City!{SCROLL}You’re finally heading for Kanto,{NEWLINE}aren’t you?{SCROLL}My lab is in a little town called Pallet{NEWLINE}Town. If you’re ever nearby, let me see{CLEAR}your Pokédex!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0255/13 | RV051: meaning: zh asks to see Pokédex, asks about Kanto (D-1730)

strings.zh: 新圣安努号依靠{NEWLINE}喷射的能量,{SCROLL}得以在海面上{NEWLINE}高速地航行！
strings.en: The new S.S. Anne runs on jet power, so{NEWLINE}it can race across the sea at high{CLEAR}speed!

strings.zh: 你是从关东来的？{SCROLL}貌似那里有着许多珍稀的精灵呢！{CLEAR}真好啊~我也想去呐~
strings.en: You came from Kanto?{SCROLL}I hear there are lots of rare Pokémon{NEWLINE}over there!{SCROLL}Lucky you~ I want to go too~
strings.notes: US 0255/15 | RV051: meaning: zh asks if player came from Kanto (D-1730)

strings.zh: 欢迎光临浅葱码头！{SCROLL}为了保证城都地区的航运畅通,{NEWLINE}精灵联盟已经将浅葱码头{CLEAR}彻底翻新了一遍,{CLEAR}请从这崭新的码头{CLEAR}开始您的海上之旅吧。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome to Olivine Harbor!{SCROLL}To keep Johto’s shipping running{NEWLINE}smoothly, the Pokémon League has fully{CLEAR}renovated Olivine Harbor.{SCROLL}Please begin your sea voyage from this{NEWLINE}brand-new harbor.{SCROLL}
